title: Stop! Never leave your car in neutral.
hook: Stop! Never leave your car in neutral.

script.narration: Stop! Never leave your car in neutral. Your parking pawl is a tiny metal pin inside your transmission that holds the entire weight of your vehicle.
script.visual_search: car parked on a steep hill

script.narration: Step one: come to a complete stop with your foot firmly on the brake pedal.
Step two: shift into neutral and engage your parking brake first to secure the weight.
script.visual_search: hand pulling up mechanical parking brake

script.narration: Step three: only then shift into park. This prevents that heavy clunking noise when you leave.
script.visual_search: automatic gear shifter moving to park

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Do you use your parking brake every time? Comment yes or no, because

description: Learn the correct sequence to park your automatic car to avoid expensive transmission damage. This quick guide explains how to use your parking brake effectively to protect your vehicle's parking pawl.
why_it_will_work: Focuses on a mechanical 'hack' that prevents damage, a topic that historically performs well for new drivers seeking practical vehicle advice.
